title: pnpm db:migrate: the platform and reference sets
caption: packages/db/src/migrate/run-set.ts and cli/migrate.ts. DSN only from DATABASE_MIGRATOR_URL (never a flag, never printed). Exit 0 ok, 1 error, 2 checksum mismatch.

steps.label: read and validate every file (names, headers, UTF-8, R__ rules)
steps.note: Folder missing → notice on stderr, nothing applied, exit 0.

steps.label: pg_advisory_lock(hashtext('velexis:migrate:platform'))
steps.note: A second run waits up to 10 minutes, then finds nothing pending.

steps.label: verify checksums of applied files
steps.note: Mismatch → one checksum_mismatch line per file, exit 2, nothing applied.

steps.label: per pending NNNN file: BEGIN; SET LOCAL lock_timeout 5s, statement_timeout 10min; file; ledger row; COMMIT
per changed R__ file: same, ledger row updated (phase repeatable)
stdout: one JSON line per file applied/failed/changed
